title: Rum & Cigar Tour With An Expert In Little Havana
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a cigar expert in the Cuban neighborhood of Little Havana in Miami and learn about the art of cigar rolling. You will be visiting an authentic cigar factory and learn the process of how quality cigars are made. From seed to the hands of a master roller with decades of experience, you will be introduced to world-renowned expert torcedores.
